neighbours.label: ' blood' where the context is classifying it (blood type / blood group), not blood as a fluid
fire: Before the transfusion the nurse checked the patient's blood type on the chart.
Each donor card lists the holder's blood group and allergies.

The registry matches recipients by blood type and tissue markers.
On the form, write your name, date of birth and blood group.
quiet: After the fall the hiker lost a lot of blood from a cut on his leg.
The knife was wiped clean, but a drop of blood remained on the handle.

The heart pumps blood through thousands of miles of vessels.
Sharks can smell blood in the water from far away.

His face turned red as blood rushed to his cheeks.
